3621.title: Missing service sender provenance
3621.rootCauseOneLine: Sender-less internal inputs persist user/null through the actual send path; originating-thread and retry controls retain distinct attribution.
3621.proposedFix: Design authenticated service provenance across send and turn contracts.
3621.caveats: Two clean normal-build runs passed six selected tests each. Human and service labels share the same internal input shape; real plugin routing, pluginSubmission semantics, UI, authorization and agent behavior remain untested. High confidence in the bounded persistence path; medium for the original plugin journey.
